name: Earthskin
body:
School: abjuration; Level: alchemist 3, cleric/oracle, druid 3, inquisitor 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3

CASTING

Components: V, S
Casting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: 1 minute/level or until discharged

DESCRIPTION

You gain resistance to physical damage. You gain damage reduction 5/adamantine. The spell prevents a total of 5 hp damage per caster level (maximum 50 points). The protection ends when these points are expended.

The effects of this spell stack with the effects of stoneskin. If you are protected by both, stoneskin absorbs damage first, then when that is discharged the earthskin functions normally.
